descriptions.invoice_number: The explicitly labelled invoice or bill identifier on the document, excluding contract, order, or contact IDs.
descriptions.total_gross: The printed total gross amount following document labels without arithmetic invention or calculation.
descriptions.total_net: The printed total net amount following document labels without arithmetic invention or calculation.
descriptions.total_vat: The printed total tax or VAT amount following document labels without arithmetic invention or calculation.
descriptions.amount_due: The printed total amount due following document labels without arithmetic invention or calculation.
descriptions.seller_vat_id: The seller Value Added Tax (VAT) identifier only, excluding EIN, FCC ID, or station callsign.
descriptions.seller_name: The paid media seller or broadcast station issuing the invoice.
descriptions.buyer_name: The explicitly billed advertiser or agency.
descriptions.issue_date: The explicit printed date when the invoice was issued.
descriptions.due_date: The explicit printed payment due date on the document, which must never be calculated or inferred from payment terms.

authority: advisory only; Python validation and human signature required
